energy-mission.description: Explore Energy Mission industrial machines and manufacturing solutions.

hero.title: Energy Mission CNC Press Brakes
hero.description: Discover precision metal bending solutions from Energy Mission, designed to support accurate sheet metal forming, consistent production quality and efficient industrial manufacturing.

intro.subtitle: Metal Forming Solutions
intro.heading: Energy Mission CNC Press Brake Machines
intro.description: Energy Mission offers a comprehensive range of press brake machines for sheet metal bending and industrial fabrication. From high-speed CNC bending to heavy-duty applications and conventional hydraulic solutions, explore the Optima, Splendid, Efficient, Tandem / Tridem, Magnum, Prudent, NC Press Brake and Hydraulic Press Brake ranges. Contact MTAT Technologies for product availability, machine configurations and technical specifications.

products.title: Optima
products.desc: The Optima Series is designed for precision and productivity in CNC metal bending. Its servo-motor-controlled hydraulic pump system supports accurate Y1 and Y2 axis positioning, while high beam speeds and advanced CNC controls help improve production efficiency. Suitable for manufacturers seeking precise, repeatable bending performance with reduced energy consumption.

products.title: Splendid
products.desc: The Splendid Series combines hydraulic bending power with controlled, consistent operation for precision metal fabrication. Designed for intricate bending applications, it supports smooth machine operation and accurate forming. Its quick-release tooling arrangements help simplify tool changes and reduce changeover time.

products.title: Efficient
products.desc: The Efficient Series focuses on productive and accurate sheet metal bending for industrial manufacturing. Its CNC-controlled bending operations and efficient positioning capabilities help streamline production cycles and maintain consistency across repeat jobs. A practical solution for fabrication businesses handling varied production requirements.

products.title: Tandem / Tridem
products.desc: Energy Mission Tandem / Tridem CNC Press Brakes are designed for applications requiring extended bending lengths and high-capacity metal forming. Synchronized operation of multiple press brakes enables the processing of oversized workpieces and supports demanding industrial fabrication requirements. Suitable configurations depend on the application and machine specifications.

products.title: Magnum
products.desc: The Magnum Series is developed for heavy-duty metal bending applications that demand substantial bending force and robust machine construction. Its heavy-duty design supports the processing of thick metal plates and large components for industrial fabrication. Select the appropriate machine capacity according to material thickness, bending length and production requirements.

products.title: Prudent
products.desc: The Prudent Series offers a compact, practical approach to CNC sheet metal bending. Designed for workshops and manufacturers with specialized production needs, it combines controlled bending operations with a space-conscious machine design. An option for businesses seeking reliable metal forming capabilities suited to their available workspace and production demands.

products.title: NC Press Brake (Front)
products.desc: The NC Press Brake (Front) provides numerically controlled metal bending for manufacturing and fabrication applications. Its front-cylinder configuration offers an alternative within Energy Mission's NC press brake range. A suitable choice for businesses seeking controlled bending operations without requiring every feature of an advanced CNC system. Confirm the available controls and configuration before selection.

products.title: NC Press Brake (Rear)
products.desc: The NC Press Brake (Rear) is designed for controlled sheet metal bending in industrial production environments. Its rear-cylinder configuration offers an alternative for manufacturers evaluating press brake designs for their operational requirements. Contact MTAT Technologies to confirm machine capacity, control options, dimensions and suitability for your application.

products.title: Hydraulic Press Brake
products.desc: Energy Mission Hydraulic Press Brakes provide hydraulic-powered metal forming for a variety of industrial bending applications. Designed to accommodate different fabrication requirements, these machines offer a practical solution for forming sheet metal and metal plates. Available configurations and optional features should be confirmed according to the required bending force, working length and application.

hero.title: Energy Mission Shearing Machines
hero.description: Explore industrial shearing machines from Energy Mission, engineered for efficient sheet metal cutting, accurate sizing and reliable performance across metal fabrication applications.

intro.subtitle: Precision Metal Cutting
intro.heading: Energy Mission Shearing Machines
intro.description: Energy Mission offers a range of industrial shearing solutions for cutting sheet metal and metal plates to the required dimensions. Explore CNC Shearing, NC Shearing and Hydraulic Shearing machines designed for different levels of automation and production requirements. Contact MTAT Technologies to identify the right machine based on material thickness, cutting length, production volume and required control features.

products.title: CNC Shearing Machine
products.desc: Energy Mission CNC Hydraulic Shearing Machines are designed for precise and efficient sheet metal cutting in modern fabrication environments. Computer-controlled operation and programmable positioning options help improve cutting consistency and production workflow. The range includes variable rake angle configurations suited to different sheet thicknesses. Cutting capacity, controller options and available accessories depend on the selected machine configuration.

products.title: NC Shearing Machine
products.desc: Energy Mission NC Shearing Machines provide numerically controlled metal cutting for manufacturing units and fabrication workshops. NC controls can simplify back gauge positioning and repetitive cutting operations, helping operators achieve consistent dimensions with reduced manual adjustment. These machines are suitable for businesses seeking a balance between operational control, productivity and investment. Confirm the available controller, positioning functions and cutting capacity for the selected configuration.

products.title: Hydraulic Shearing Machine
products.desc: Energy Mission Hydraulic Shearing Machines are designed for dependable sheet metal and plate cutting across industrial fabrication applications. The hydraulic guillotine design with variable rake angle supports cutting requirements across different material thicknesses. Features such as adjustable blade clearance and back gauge options can help improve cut quality and dimensional consistency. Machine capacity, control options and accessories should be selected according to the material, thickness and required cutting length.

hero.title: Energy Mission Hydraulic Presses
hero.description: Discover industrial hydraulic press machines from Energy Mission, engineered for controlled pressing, metal forming, deep drawing and precision manufacturing applications.

intro.subtitle: Industrial Metal Forming
intro.heading: Energy Mission Hydraulic Press Machines
intro.description: Energy Mission manufactures hydraulic press machines for a wide range of industrial pressing and metal forming applications. Explore H Frame Press, C Frame Press, Deep Drawing Press and Servo Press configurations designed to meet different workpiece sizes, forming requirements and production needs. Contact MTAT Technologies for assistance with machine selection, available configurations and technical specifications.

products.title: H Frame Press
products.desc: Energy Mission H Frame Hydraulic Presses feature a robust frame structure designed to handle demanding industrial pressing operations. Their rigid construction and adjustable dovetail guides support heavy-duty applications involving metal forming, straightening, assembly and general-purpose pressing. The H-frame design provides a stable working structure for manufacturers handling larger workpieces and substantial pressing loads. Select the machine capacity and configuration according to your application requirements.

products.title: C Frame Press
products.desc: Energy Mission C Frame Hydraulic Presses are designed for pressing applications that require convenient access to the working area. The compact C-shaped frame facilitates workpiece positioning and handling from multiple sides, making the machine suitable for punching, metal forming, assembly and other workshop operations. Different table sizes and throat depths can accommodate varying job requirements. Contact MTAT Technologies to confirm the available capacity and configuration for your application.

products.title: Deep Drawing Press
products.desc: Energy Mission Deep Drawing Hydraulic Presses are designed to transform flat metal sheets into hollow components and formed parts through controlled drawing operations. Available press configurations can include single-action, double-action and triple-action designs to suit different tooling and forming requirements. Hydraulic cushion arrangements and controlled pressing movements support applications where material flow and forming consistency are important. Suitable for manufacturers producing metal housings, containers, cookware components and other deep-drawn parts. Confirm the required press design and tooling configuration before selection.

products.title: Servo Press
products.desc: Energy Mission Servo Presses combine hydraulic pressing technology with servo-driven control for applications requiring controlled pressing performance. Programmable operation can help manage pressing movements and improve process consistency according to the selected configuration. Available designs include H Type, C Type and Piller Type structures, allowing manufacturers to evaluate different machine layouts for their production needs. Suitable applications include precision forming, pressing and industrial assembly. Contact MTAT Technologies to verify the control system, available options and technical specifications.

singhal-press.name: Singhal Press (SEW)
singhal-press.description: Explore SEW mechanical power presses, cross-shaft presses, eccentric-drive presses, link-motion power presses and integrated coil-feeding automation systems for precision metal stamping and industrial manufacturing.

hero.title: SEW Cross Shaft Power Presses
hero.description: Explore precision-engineered cross-shaft power presses designed for metal stamping, blanking, punching and forming operations across industrial manufacturing applications.

intro.subtitle: Precision Metal Stamping
intro.heading: SEW Cross Shaft Press Machines
intro.description: SEW offers cross-shaft power presses in C-frame and ring-frame configurations for a range of metalworking requirements. Explore the SNX, SNX-2, SNXR and SLXR series for applications involving stamping, blanking, punching and forming. Machine capacity, frame configuration and automation options vary by model. Contact MTAT Technologies for technical details and assistance selecting the appropriate press.

products.title: SNX Series Single Point C Frame Cross Shaft Power Presses
products.desc: The SNX Series features a single-point C-frame cross-shaft design for industrial metal stamping and forming. Its precision crankshaft, guided slide, programmable electronic cam system and integrated control features support repeatable production operations. Available capacities range from 25 to 320 tonnes, depending on the model.

products.title: SNX Series Two Point C Frame Cross Shaft Power Presses
products.desc: The SNX-2 Series is a double-crank C-frame cross-shaft power press designed for two-point slide suspension. It supports stamping and forming operations that benefit from distributed slide support and a wider working area. Programmable controls and available automation accessories help manufacturers configure the press for their production requirements.

products.title: SNXR Series Ring Frame Cross Shaft Power Presses
products.desc: The SNXR Series uses a ring-frame structure with a cross-shaft drive arrangement for industrial stamping and forming applications. The frame design supports demanding production operations where rigidity and consistent slide movement are important. Confirm the available tonnage, dimensions and tooling compatibility for the required configuration.

products.title: SLXR Series Link Motion Cross Shaft Geared Ring Frame Press
products.desc: The SLXR Series combines a geared ring-frame construction with cross-shaft and link-motion technology. It is suited to progressive metal forming applications where controlled slide movement, production consistency and resistance to off-centre loading are important. Confirm the required tonnage, stroke, tooling arrangement and available configuration with MTAT Technologies.

hero.title: SEW Two Point Power Presses
hero.description: Discover two-point power presses engineered for stable slide guidance, precision stamping and demanding metal forming applications in industrial production.

intro.subtitle: High-Precision Pressing
intro.heading: SEW Two Point Power Press Machines
intro.description: SEW's two-point press range includes C-frame, H-frame and straight-sided configurations for different stamping and forming requirements. Explore the SNX-2, SXP, SCL-2, HMX, SDC and APH series, along with the AIDA C2-200-2 model listed in the manufacturer's catalogue. Select a press according to the required tonnage, bolster dimensions, stroke, tooling and production process.

products.title: SNX Series Two Point C Frame Cross Shaft Power Presses
products.desc: The SNX-2 Series features a double-crank C-frame design with two-point slide suspension. It is intended for metal stamping and forming operations requiring a wider working area and balanced slide support. The range includes multiple capacities and offers control and automation options according to the selected configuration.

products.title: SXP Series Double Column Two Point H Frame Power Presses
products.desc: The SXP Series is a double-column H-frame mechanical power press with two-point slide suspension. Its stress-relieved fabricated-steel construction, eight-point slide gibbing and pneumatic clutch-brake arrangement support stable operation. The manufacturer lists applications including shallow drawing, forming, blanking and piercing.

products.title: SCL-2 Series H Frame Two Point Eccentric Drive Power Presses
products.desc: The SCL-2 Series is an H-frame two-point power press featuring an eccentric-drive arrangement. It is designed for demanding stamping, blanking and forming applications that benefit from two-point slide support and a rigid frame structure. The manufacturer offers different configurations to accommodate varying production and tooling requirements.

products.title: HMX Series Straight Sided Two Point Link Motion Power Presses
products.desc: The HMX Series is a straight-sided two-point link-motion press developed for progressive die and precision stamping applications. Its rigid frame and widely spaced suspension points help manage off-centre loads. The series supports manufacturing processes such as blanking, bending and shallow drawing, including applications involving precision components.

products.title: SDC Series Straight Sided Double Column Two Point Power Press
products.desc: The SDC Series is a straight-sided, double-column two-point power press intended for industrial stamping and forming. Its two-point configuration provides distributed slide support for suitable tooling and production applications. Confirm the available tonnage, stroke, bolster dimensions and drive configuration with MTAT Technologies.

products.title: APH Series H Frame Two Point High Speed Presses
products.desc: The APH Series is a high-speed H-frame two-point press designed for continuous stamping operations. Its stress-relieved frame, precision slide guidance and dynamic balancing features support stable production at high operating speeds. It is suited to high-volume manufacturing where repeatability, rigidity and consistent stamping quality are important.

products.title: AIDA C2-200-2 Two Point C Frame Cross Shaft Power Press
products.desc: The AIDA C2-200-2 is listed in SEW's catalogue as a two-point C-frame cross-shaft power press. It provides an option for manufacturers evaluating a two-point press configuration for industrial stamping and forming. Confirm the machine's condition, availability, specifications and commercial terms before purchase.

hero.title: SEW Eccentric Drive Power Presses
hero.description: Explore eccentric-drive mechanical power presses designed for industrial blanking, punching, cutting, stamping and metal forming operations.

intro.subtitle: Mechanical Power Presses
intro.heading: SEW Eccentric Drive Press Machines
intro.description: Eccentric-drive power presses convert rotary drive motion into reciprocating slide movement for industrial metalworking. SEW's SCL-1 and SCL-2 series provide single-point and two-point H-frame configurations for different production needs. The COTELLI-130 T is also listed in the manufacturer's used-press catalogue and should be treated as a pre-owned machine.

products.title: SCL-1 Series H Frame Single Point Eccentric Drive Power Presses
products.desc: The SCL-1 Series is an H-frame single-point eccentric-drive power press developed for heavy blanking, forming and stamping. Its symmetrical frame, extended stroke options and guided slide design support demanding metalworking operations. The range is suitable for manufacturers requiring a robust mechanical press for cutting, bending, punching and shallow forming applications.

products.title: SCL-2 Series H Frame Two Point Eccentric Drive Power Presses
products.desc: The SCL-2 Series combines an eccentric-drive mechanism with a two-point H-frame configuration. Designed for industrial stamping, blanking and forming, it provides a rigid working structure and distributed slide support for suitable tooling arrangements. Multiple configurations are available to meet different capacity and production requirements.

products.title: COTELLI-130 T C Frame Mechanical Eccentric Press
products.desc: The COTELLI-130 T is a 130-tonne C-frame mechanical eccentric press listed in SEW's used-press catalogue. Published specifications include a 150 mm adjustable stroke and a 650 × 1,100 mm table. As this is a pre-owned machine listing, confirm current availability, condition, service history and specifications before purchase.

hero.title: SEW Link Motion Power Presses
hero.description: Discover link-motion power presses engineered for progressive die stamping, precision forming and demanding high-productivity metalworking applications.

intro.subtitle: Progressive Die Technology
intro.heading: SEW Link Motion Power Press Machines
intro.description: SEW's link-motion press range includes straight-sided two-point and ring-frame configurations designed for progressive stamping and precision forming. Explore the HMX and SLXR series for applications involving blanking, bending and shallow drawing. Select the appropriate configuration according to the tooling layout, required capacity, material and production rate.

products.title: HMX Series Straight Sided Two Point Link Motion Power Presses
products.desc: The HMX Series is designed for progressive forming and high-precision stamping. Its link-motion mechanism supports controlled slide movement, while the straight-sided frame and widely spaced suspension points help accommodate off-centre loads. Suitable processes include precision blanking, bending and shallow drawing for demanding production applications.

products.title: SLXR Series Link Motion Cross Shaft Geared Ring Frame Press
products.desc: The SLXR Series combines link-motion technology with a geared ring-frame cross-shaft press design. It is intended for progressive metal forming and stamping operations that require controlled slide movement and a rigid press structure. Confirm the required tonnage, tooling arrangement, stroke and machine configuration with MTAT Technologies.

hero.title: SEW Knuckle Joint Presses
hero.description: Explore knuckle joint power presses designed for specialized metal forming and precision stamping applications requiring a dedicated mechanical linkage.

intro.subtitle: Specialized Metal Forming
intro.heading: SEW Knuckle Joint Power Press
intro.description: SEW knuckle joint presses use a mechanical linkage mechanism to deliver a specialized slide-motion profile for suitable forming and stamping applications. The range includes multiple machine capacities, with model selection depending on the required pressing force, stroke, die dimensions and production process. Contact MTAT Technologies for current specifications and application guidance.

products.title: SEW Knuckle Joint Press
products.desc: The SEW Knuckle Joint Press range is designed for specialized industrial pressing and metal forming operations. Its knuckle-link mechanism produces a distinct mechanical motion profile suited to applications that require controlled forming action. Published models include GK-400, GK-630, GK-800, GK-1000, GK-1200, GK-1600 and GK-2500. Confirm model-specific capacity, stroke and operating specifications before selection.

hero.title: SEW Coil Feeding Automation Systems
hero.description: Improve coil handling and press-feeding workflows with integrated decoiling, straightening and servo-feeding solutions designed for industrial sheet metal production.

intro.subtitle: Automated Coil Processing
intro.heading: SEW 2-in-1 and 3-in-1 Automation Lines
intro.description: SEW provides coil-feeding equipment and integrated automation lines for sheet metal processing. The range includes NC servo feeders, 2-in-1 decoiler-cum-straighteners and MAF-series 3-in-1 lines. These systems combine material handling, straightening and feeding functions according to the selected configuration, helping streamline coil processing and supply material to downstream presses. Choose a system based on material width, thickness, coil weight and required feed rate.

products.title: NC Servo Feeder & 2-in-1 Decoiler-cum-Straightener
products.desc: This product combines an NC servo feeder with a decoiler-cum-straightener arrangement for automated coil handling and material feeding. The integrated configuration supports unwinding, straightening and accurately feeding strip material into a press or production line. Select the appropriate setup according to material width, thickness, coil weight and feed requirements.

products.title: MAF3 Series 3-in-1 Automation Line
products.desc: The MAF3 Series is a 3-in-1 coil-processing line identified by SEW for thin-material applications. It integrates coil handling, straightening and feeding functions into a coordinated system. Material thickness, coil capacity, working width and operating speed depend on the selected model and material requirements.

products.title: MAF4 Series 3-in-1 Automation Line
products.desc: The MAF4 Series combines decoiling, straightening and servo feeding in an integrated coil-processing line. The manufacturer lists multiple material-width configurations, allowing the system to be matched to different sheet metal handling requirements. Confirm material thickness, coil weight, line speed and model compatibility before selection.

products.title: MAF6 Series 3-in-1 Automation Line
products.desc: The MAF6 Series is an integrated 3-in-1 coil-processing system for automated decoiling, straightening and feeding. Available configurations accommodate different material widths and thickness requirements. It is intended to support consistent material supply to press and stamping operations while reducing the need for separate material-handling units.

products.title: MAF6G Series 3-in-1 Automation Line
products.desc: The MAF6G Series is a 3-in-1 automation line designed for integrated coil handling, straightening and servo feeding. The manufacturer lists configurations for a range of material widths and thicknesses, with capacity depending on the selected model and material properties. Consult MTAT Technologies to identify the appropriate line for your production requirements.

sukrit.name: SUKRIT
sukrit.description: Explore Sukrit machine tools, including all-electric servo press brakes designed for precision sheet metal bending, energy efficiency and productive manufacturing.

hero.title: Sukrit Ball Screw Driven Press Brakes
hero.description: Discover precision ball-screw-driven press brakes designed for accurate sheet metal bending, repeatable positioning and efficient industrial production.

intro.subtitle: Precision Bending Technology
intro.heading: Sukrit Ball Screw Driven Press Brakes
intro.description: Sukrit's ECO-Bend EB Series uses brushless AC servo motors and a synchronized dual ball-screw drive to move the press beam. This all-electric design supports accurate, repeatable bending, fast movement and reduced energy consumption. The manufacturer lists three models: 22 Ton × 900 mm, 22 Ton × 1250 mm and 40 Ton × 1600 mm.

products.title: ECO-Bend EB 22 Ton × 900 mm
products.desc: A compact all-electric press brake designed for precision bending of smaller sheet metal components. Its servo-driven ball-screw mechanism supports accurate ram positioning and repeatable bending operations. Suitable for manufacturers seeking productive bending performance in a compact working format.

products.title: ECO-Bend EB 22 Ton × 1250 mm
products.desc: The 22-tonne ECO-Bend EB model with a 1250 mm working length combines servo-electric actuation with ball-screw-driven beam movement. It is designed for repeatable sheet metal bending, with programmable controls and backgauge options to support different component geometries.

products.title: ECO-Bend EB 40 Ton × 1600 mm
products.desc: The 40-tonne ECO-Bend EB model with a 1600 mm working length offers a higher-capacity option within Sukrit's all-electric press brake range. Servo-driven ball screws support controlled beam movement and repeatable bending for suitable sheet metal fabrication applications.

hero.title: Sukrit Belt Driven Machines
hero.description: Explore Sukrit machine tools and discuss the right drive configuration for your manufacturing requirements with MTAT Technologies.

intro.subtitle: Industrial Drive Systems
intro.heading: Sukrit Belt Driven Machine Solutions
intro.description: Sukrit documents belt-driven power transmission in its CNC turning machine range. However, its published ECO-Bend press brake documentation describes a servo-electric, ball-screw-driven design rather than a belt-driven press brake. Contact MTAT Technologies to confirm whether a suitable belt-driven product is available for this category.

hero.title: Sukrit Servo Electric Press Brakes
hero.description: Experience precision sheet metal bending with Sukrit's ECO-Bend all-electric press brakes, featuring servo-driven movement, programmable controls and energy-efficient operation.

intro.subtitle: All-Electric Press Brake Technology
intro.heading: Sukrit ECO-Bend Servo Electric Press Brakes
intro.description: Sukrit's ECO-Bend EB Series combines brushless AC servo motors, synchronized ball screws and CNC controls to deliver controlled, repeatable sheet metal bending. The all-electric drive eliminates the hydraulic oil, pumps, valves and cylinders associated with conventional hydraulic press brakes. Published models include 22 Ton × 900 mm, 22 Ton × 1250 mm and 40 Ton × 1600 mm. Contact MTAT Technologies for current availability and configuration details.

products.title: ECO-Bend EB CNC Servo Electric Press Brake
products.desc: Sukrit's ECO-Bend EB Series is an all-electric CNC press brake designed for accurate and productive sheet metal bending. Brushless AC servo motors drive synchronized ball screws to move the press beam, supporting precise positioning and repeatable results. Features include a touchscreen controller, programmable Y-axis, direct angle programming, angle correction, stroke control and CNC backgauge options. Available model sizes listed by the manufacturer are 22 Ton × 900 mm, 22 Ton × 1250 mm and 40 Ton × 1600 mm.

hexagon.name: Hexagon
hexagon.description: Explore Hexagon metrology solutions, coordinate measuring machines, optical measuring systems, portable measuring arms and machine-tool probing technologies.

hero.title: Optical Light Measuring Machines (OLM)
hero.description: Discover Hexagon optical and multisensor measuring systems designed for accurate dimensional inspection of precision components.

intro.subtitle: Metrology
intro.heading: Hexagon Optical Measuring Machines
intro.description: Hexagon optical coordinate measuring systems combine non-contact vision measurement with configurable sensor technologies for inspecting delicate, complex and precision-manufactured components. Confirm regional availability and configurations with MTAT Technologies.

products.title: OPTIV M
products.desc: OPTIV M is a modular multisensor optical coordinate measuring machine family designed for dimensional inspection of precision parts. Depending on configuration, it can combine vision measurement with tactile probing and other sensor options.

products.title: OPTIV Reference
products.desc: OPTIV Reference is a high-accuracy multisensor coordinate measuring system for demanding inspection applications. Its OPTIV Dual technology supports optical and tactile measurement using independent sensor axes.

products.title: VISIUS
products.desc: VISIUS is an optical coordinate measuring machine designed for automated, high-speed 2D vision measurement. It supports non-contact inspection of small features and delicate components, with guided workflows through Metus software.

hero.title: Coordinate Measuring Machine (CMM)
hero.description: Explore Hexagon coordinate measuring machines for accurate dimensional inspection, quality control and precision manufacturing.

intro.subtitle: Metrology
intro.heading: Hexagon Coordinate Measuring Machines
intro.description: Hexagon CMM solutions support dimensional inspection across laboratories and production environments. The portfolio includes high-performance systems, versatile bridge CMMs and machines designed for shop-floor measurement. Confirm machine configuration and regional availability with MTAT Technologies.

products.title: MAESTRO
products.desc: MAESTRO is an all-digital, connected coordinate measuring machine platform designed to support high-throughput inspection, adaptable measurement configurations and integration with modern manufacturing systems.

products.title: GLORY
products.desc: GLORY is a configurable coordinate measuring machine platform for general-purpose dimensional inspection. Available configurations support touch-trigger probing, scanning probes and optical sensors to suit different measurement requirements.

products.title: ENSPEC
products.desc: ENSPEC is a bridge CMM range designed to make professional-grade dimensional measurement accessible to growing manufacturers. Its configurations support different inspection tasks, with PC-DMIS metrology software and upgrade options.

products.title: TIGO SF
products.desc: TIGO SF is a compact, protected coordinate measuring machine designed for shop-floor inspection. Its robust construction and enclosed moving components support reliable measurement in demanding production environments.

products.title: Leitz Reference
products.desc: Leitz Reference is a high-accuracy bridge coordinate measuring machine designed for demanding form and profile tolerances. Configurations can be selected to suit precision inspection and metrology laboratory requirements.

products.title: OPTIV M
products.desc: OPTIV M is a multisensor optical CMM family for measuring geometric features on precision parts. Depending on the selected configuration, vision, tactile probing and additional sensors can be combined in one inspection workflow.

products.title: OPTIV Reference
products.desc: OPTIV Reference is a high-precision multisensor CMM intended for complex three-dimensional measurements. Its optical and tactile sensor options support inspection in demanding manufacturing and metrology applications.

products.title: VISIUS
products.desc: VISIUS is an optical CMM for fast, non-contact 2D dimensional measurement. It is designed for production quality control where speed, straightforward operation and repeatable measurement results are important.

hero.title: Romer Arm (Portable Arm)
hero.description: Discover Hexagon portable measuring arms for flexible, high-accuracy probing, 3D laser scanning and dimensional inspection directly at the component.

intro.subtitle: Portable Metrology
intro.heading: Hexagon Absolute Arm
intro.description: Hexagon Absolute Arm systems bring portable metrology to inspection laboratories, production floors and large components. Select from configurations designed for tactile probing, 3D scanning and access to confined measurement areas.

products.title: Absolute Arm 7-Axis
products.desc: The Absolute Arm 7-Axis combines tactile probing with 3D laser scanning and optional non-destructive testing capabilities. Its articulated design supports flexible inspection of complex geometries and hard-to-reach features.

products.title: Absolute Arm 6-Axis
products.desc: The Absolute Arm 6-Axis is designed primarily for precise tactile probing. It provides a portable measurement solution for inspection tasks in laboratories, workshops and manufacturing environments.

products.title: Absolute Arm Compact
products.desc: Absolute Arm Compact is a portable measuring-arm configuration intended for high-accuracy probing in compact workspaces and applications where access around small or complex components is important.

hero.title: Tool and Job Probes
hero.description: Explore Hexagon machine-tool probing systems and tool setters for workpiece alignment, in-process measurement and reliable tool inspection.

intro.subtitle: Machine Tool Metrology
intro.heading: Hexagon Tool and Workpiece Probing Systems
intro.description: Hexagon machine-tool measurement solutions help manufacturers establish workpiece positions, inspect dimensions during machining and measure tool geometry. The portfolio includes tactile probes, radio and infrared probing systems, and tool setters. Confirm compatibility with the machine tool and controller before ordering.

products.title: m&h TP-R-400
products.desc: The m&h TP-R-400 is a radio-wave touch probe for workpiece measurement directly on compatible machine tools. Its modular design supports flexible probing applications during setup and production.

products.title: m&h RWP20.50
products.desc: The m&h RWP20.50 is a radio-wave touch-probe system with a modular design and interchangeable measuring units. It supports workpiece setup, alignment and in-process inspection on compatible machine tools.

products.title: m&h TS-R-400 Tool Setter
products.desc: The m&h TS-R-400 is a radio tool-setting system used to determine tool geometry. Tool measurement data can support machine setup and production quality when used with a compatible machine-tool system.

products.title: m&h IRT35.70 Infrared Tool Setter
products.desc: The m&h IRT35.70 is an infrared tool setter designed for milling machines and machining centres. It measures tool geometry directly on the machine and supports automated tool measurement workflows.

products.title: m&h LTS35.65 Laser Tool Setter
products.desc: The m&h LTS35.65 is a non-contact laser tool setter for tool measurement, machine setup and tool-breakage monitoring. Confirm the appropriate model and machine compatibility for the intended application.

products.title: m&h TS35.20 Tool Setter
products.desc: The m&h TS35.20 is a tactile tool setter for milling and machining centres. It is designed to determine tool geometry as part of a machine-tool measurement workflow.

sodick.name: Sodick
sodick.description: Explore Sodick precision EDM machines engineered for accurate machining, complex geometries, fine surface finishes and demanding toolroom applications.

hero.title: Sodick EDM Machines
hero.description: Discover CNC sinker EDM and small-hole EDM solutions for precision mold making, die manufacturing and intricate machining applications.

intro.subtitle: Electrical Discharge Machining
intro.heading: Sodick CNC EDM Machines
intro.description: Sodick electrical discharge machining systems use controlled electrical discharges to machine electrically conductive materials. Explore sinker EDM and small-hole drilling solutions for precision cavities, molds, dies and fine holes. Confirm the suitable machine configuration with MTAT Technologies.

products.title: AD Series
products.desc: Sodick AD Series CNC sinker EDM machines are designed for precision cavity machining, mold making and general production applications. Linear motor technology and advanced discharge control support accurate machining and fine surface finishes.

products.title: ALG+ Series
products.desc: The Sodick ALG+ Series combines linear motor drives, advanced discharge control and CNC programming technology for precision die-sinking operations. It is designed for accurate cavity machining and demanding mold and die applications.

products.title: AG Series
products.desc: Sodick AG Series sinker EDM machines provide high-precision electrical discharge machining for molds, dies and complex conductive components. The range includes machines for different workpiece sizes and production requirements.

products.title: AP30L
products.desc: The AP30L is a high-precision sinker EDM designed for micro-machining applications requiring intricate features, tight tolerances and fine surface finishes. Its oil-dielectric technology supports demanding precision applications.

products.title: K1C
products.desc: The Sodick K1C is a manually operated small-hole EDM drilling machine designed for producing small holes in electrically conductive materials. It offers a straightforward solution for specialised drilling requirements.

products.title: K3HS
products.desc: The Sodick K3HS is a CNC-controlled small-hole EDM drilling machine designed for production applications that require repeatable hole machining and automated operation capabilities.

products.title: K4HL
products.desc: The Sodick K4HL is a small-hole EDM drilling solution designed for extended production operation and automation compatibility. It is suitable for manufacturers requiring consistent hole drilling in conductive workpieces.

products.title: K1BL
products.desc: The Sodick K1BL is designed for specialised small-hole EDM applications, including very small holes in electrically conductive materials. Confirm electrode, hole-size and workpiece requirements for the intended application.

products.title: K3BL
products.desc: The Sodick K3BL is a small-hole drilling EDM designed for precision drilling across a range of electrode and hole sizes. Automation options can support production workflows requiring repeated drilling operations.

hero.title: Sodick Wire EDM Machines
hero.description: Explore precision wire-cut EDM machines designed for intricate profiles, accurate contours, fine finishes and complex tooling applications.

intro.subtitle: Wire Electrical Discharge Machining
intro.heading: Sodick Precision Wire EDM
intro.description: Sodick Wire EDM machines use a continuously fed wire electrode to cut complex shapes in electrically conductive materials. The range includes high-performance production machines, precision die-machining systems, micro-wire EDMs and large-format machines. Select a configuration based on workpiece dimensions, taper requirements and accuracy needs.

products.title: ALN Series
products.desc: The ALN Series is a high-performance wire EDM range featuring rigid linear motor technology, advanced control systems and automated wire-threading capabilities. Models accommodate different workpiece sizes and machining requirements.

products.title: ALC Series
products.desc: Sodick ALC Series wire EDM machines combine a rigid linear motor drive system with advanced SPW power technology. The enclosed design and precision motion control support demanding production and toolroom applications.

products.title: ALP Series
products.desc: The ALP Series is engineered for high-precision wire EDM applications requiring excellent dimensional accuracy and surface finish. Its precision-oriented construction supports complex profiles and demanding die manufacturing tasks.

products.title: AP Series
products.desc: Sodick AP Series micro-wire EDM machines are designed for small, intricate components that require extremely fine machining accuracy. Oil-dielectric technology supports precision cutting and fine surface finishes.

products.title: AQ Series
products.desc: The AQ Series includes large-format wire EDM machines designed for oversized workpieces, large tooling and extreme-taper cutting applications. Multiple machine sizes provide different axis travels and work envelopes.

products.title: VN/VL Series
products.desc: Sodick VN and VL Series wire EDM machines are designed to balance precision, productivity and ease of operation. Linear motor drives and automated wire threading support consistent machining performance.

products.title: AX/EXC Series
products.desc: The AX and EXC Series are designed for high-accuracy micro-machining and applications with demanding tolerances. Their precision-oriented construction supports small features and complex geometries.

pinnacle.name: Pinnacle
pinnacle.description: Explore Pinnacle precision surface grinding machines for flatness, surface finish, dimensional accuracy and efficient production grinding.

hero.title: Semi-Automatic Surface Grinders
hero.description: Discover Pinnacle surface grinders designed for accurate flat-surface finishing, stable operation and dependable workshop performance.

intro.subtitle: Surface Grinding
intro.heading: Pinnacle Semi-Automatic Surface Grinding Machines
intro.description: Pinnacle surface grinding machines are designed for precision finishing of metal components, tools and dies. The range includes hydraulic semi-automatic reciprocating-table machines and semi-automatic rotary-table grinders. Machine selection depends on job dimensions, required surface finish and production volume.

products.title: GSH Series
products.desc: The GSH Series consists of hydraulic semi-automatic horizontal-spindle surface grinders with reciprocating tables and a moving-column design. The range covers table sizes from approximately 500 × 250 mm to 3000 × 500 mm.

products.title: PHR SEMI Series
products.desc: The PHR SEMI Series comprises semi-automatic horizontal-spindle rotary-table surface grinders. Its hydrodynamic rotary table is designed to support stable grinding of components requiring accurate flat surfaces.

hero.title: CNC Surface Grinding Machines
hero.description: Explore Pinnacle CNC surface grinders engineered for programmable grinding cycles, accurate axis movement and repeatable surface finishing.

intro.subtitle: CNC Grinding Technology
intro.heading: Pinnacle CNC Surface Grinders
intro.description: Pinnacle CNC surface grinding machines support programmable grinding cycles and precision control of machine axes. The CNC 2X and 3X series feature moving-column designs and options for automated dressing and compensation, making them suitable for precision and production grinding.

products.title: CNC 2X Series
products.desc: The CNC 2X Series comprises two-axis CNC-controlled horizontal-spindle reciprocating-table surface grinders. Automatic dressing and compensation options support repeatable grinding operations and precision finishing.

products.title: CNC 3X Series
products.desc: The CNC 3X Series offers three-axis CNC-controlled surface grinding with programmable grinding cycles. Its moving-column design, controlled axes and optional automatic dressing functions support accurate, repeatable production.

hero.title: Rotary Surface Grinding Machines
hero.description: Discover Pinnacle rotary surface grinders designed for precision grinding of flat components using horizontal or vertical spindle configurations.

intro.subtitle: Rotary Table Grinding
intro.heading: Pinnacle Rotary Surface Grinders
intro.description: Pinnacle rotary surface grinders are designed for machining components that require flatness, consistent surface finish and repeatable results. The product range includes semi-automatic, NC-controlled and CNC horizontal-spindle machines, as well as CNC vertical-spindle rotary grinders.

products.title: PHR SEMI Series
products.desc: The PHR SEMI Series features semi-automatic horizontal-spindle rotary-table surface grinders. Available table diameters range from 400 mm to 800 mm, depending on model.

products.title: PHR NC Series
products.desc: The PHR NC Series comprises NC-controlled horizontal-spindle rotary-table surface grinders for automated grinding operations. The series offers configurations with table diameters from approximately 500 mm to 1500 mm.

products.title: PHR CNC Series
products.desc: The PHR CNC Series consists of CNC-controlled horizontal-spindle rotary-table surface grinders with programmable axes and automatic dressing and compensation options. Models cover a range of component diameters and grinding requirements.

products.title: PVR CNC Series
products.desc: The PVR CNC Series features CNC-controlled vertical-spindle rotary-table surface grinders. This configuration is intended for surface grinding applications suited to vertical-spindle machining and rotary-table workholding.

kiya.name: Kiya
kiya.description: Explore Kiya precision grinding machines for internal and external cylindrical grinding, hybrid ID/OD grinding, bush and track grinding, hydraulic grinding and lip grinding applications.

hero.title: CNC Hybrid Grinder (ID/OD)
hero.description: Discover Kiya CNC hybrid grinding technology for internal, external and face grinding operations in a single setup.

intro.subtitle: CNC Precision Grinding
intro.heading: Kiya INEX Series CNC Hybrid Grinder
intro.description: The Kiya INEX Series is designed for combined internal and external grinding operations. Its dual-wheelhead arrangement supports ID, OD, face, groove, radius, step and taper grinding in a single setup, helping reduce repositioning and improve concentricity.

products.title: INEX-40
products.desc: The INEX-40 CNC hybrid grinder supports multiple internal and external grinding operations in a single chucking. Its dual independent wheelheads, rigid cast-iron bed and CNC-controlled axes are designed for accurate multi-operation grinding.

hero.title: CNC External Cylindrical Grinders
hero.description: Explore Kiya CNC cylindrical grinders for precision external grinding of shafts, rollers and cylindrical components.

intro.subtitle: Cylindrical Grinding
intro.heading: Kiya EG/AG Series CNC External Cylindrical Grinders
intro.description: Kiya EG/AG Series CNC external cylindrical grinders are designed for precision grinding of cylindrical workpieces. CNC-controlled axes, programmable grinding cycles and optional measuring and dressing accessories support repeatable production and accurate finishing.

products.title: EG Series
products.desc: The EG Series provides CNC external cylindrical grinding for small-to-medium workpieces. Its programmable grinding and dressing cycles support repeatability, dimensional control and efficient production grinding.

products.title: AG Series
products.desc: The AG Series is part of Kiya's CNC external cylindrical grinding range, designed for controlled grinding cycles and precision finishing. Confirm model capacity, controller and available options for the required application.

hero.title: CNC Internal Cylindrical Grinders
hero.description: Discover Kiya internal grinding solutions for accurate bore finishing and precision machining of internal cylindrical surfaces.

intro.subtitle: Internal Grinding
intro.heading: Kiya IG Series CNC Internal Cylindrical Grinders
intro.description: Kiya IG Series machines are designed for precision internal cylindrical grinding of bores and internal features. CNC-controlled grinding cycles support repeatable finishing for bearing components and other precision-manufactured parts.

products.title: IG Series
products.desc: The IG Series CNC internal cylindrical grinders are designed for accurate bore grinding and repeatable internal finishing. Model selection depends on bore diameter, grinding depth, workpiece dimensions and production requirements.

hero.title: CNC External Bush/Track Grinders
hero.description: Explore Kiya CNC grinding solutions for external bush, track and cylindrical component finishing.

intro.subtitle: Special-Purpose Grinding
intro.heading: Kiya EBG Series External Bush/Track Grinder
intro.description: The Kiya EBG Series is designed for external grinding applications involving bush and track-type components. Its purpose-oriented machine configuration supports repeatable finishing and dimensional consistency in production environments.

products.title: EBG Series
products.desc: The EBG Series CNC external bush and track grinder is designed for precision finishing of specialised cylindrical components. Confirm the available configuration and workpiece capacity with the manufacturer for your application.

hero.title: Hydraulic Cylindrical Grinders
hero.description: Discover Kiya hydraulic cylindrical grinding machines for reliable external and internal grinding of precision cylindrical components.

intro.subtitle: Hydraulic Grinding
intro.heading: Kiya HCG Series Hydraulic Cylindrical Grinders
intro.description: Kiya HCG Series hydraulic cylindrical grinders are designed for external and internal cylindrical grinding applications. The range includes multiple between-centres capacities and dedicated internal grinding configurations for different workpiece requirements.

products.title: HCG External Cylindrical Grinder
products.desc: The HCG external cylindrical grinding range includes machines with between-centres capacities from 450 mm to 1200 mm, depending on model. These machines are designed for external grinding of cylindrical workpieces and precision finishing.

products.title: HCG Internal Cylindrical Grinder
products.desc: The HCG internal grinding range is designed for accurate internal bore finishing. The published range includes HCG-I 450 and HCG-I 600 configurations, with specifications dependent on model.

hero.title: CNC Lip Grinder
hero.description: Explore Kiya CNC lip grinding solutions for accurate surface, lip and face grinding of bush and bearing-type components.

intro.subtitle: Precision Lip Grinding
intro.heading: Kiya LG Series CNC Lip Grinder
intro.description: The Kiya LG Series is designed for surface, lip and face grinding of flat components, bushes and bearing-type parts. Its horizontal spindle and configurable rotary table or magnetic centreless shoe provide flexibility for different component geometries.

products.title: LG 300
products.desc: The LG 300 is configured with a magnetic centreless shoe for suitable lip and face grinding applications. Its precision ball-screw-driven axis and rigid cast-iron structure support stable movement and consistent grinding results.

products.title: LG 500
products.desc: The LG 500 features a vertical rotary magnetic table for appropriate surface and lip grinding applications. The machine's rigid bed, cartridge-type wheel spindle and precision axis drive support repeatable component finishing.
